title: Source-authorized full-Q sector-law intake and conditional cylinder-limit test
purpose: Specify the exact evidence a future source owner must supply before PAH-OMC-014 can test a full-Q Gibbs cylinder state. This file is an intake contract, not a sector-weight law and not a model repair.

fixed_scope.functional_and_rates: Use exactly the PAH-001 functional and transition rates through PAH-OMC-014; no counterterm, refit, averaging or new carrier.
fixed_scope.finite_domain: Use exactly the PAH-OMC-012 full-Q disjoint union Omega_n^gr(R) and its neutral projection p_(n+1,n).
fixed_scope.component_states: Use only the normalized fixed-Q states pi_(rho_(n,R,Q)) already declared by PAH-001.
fixed_scope.cylinder: Use the grade-blind finite-support gauge- and anchor-automorphism-invariant cylinder algebra containing the R-488 observables.
fixed_scope.limit_order: Use the PAH-001 declared order LOCAL_STATE_CUTOFF, LATTICE_REFINEMENT, VOLUME_EXHAUSTION, PHASE_SELECTOR, APERTURE_COLLAPSE, optional GROUND_STATE, OBSERVATION_TIME; all topology declarations must be supplied by the future source owner.

symbolic_acceptance_conditions.sector_law: Supply a source-owned family w_(n,R,Q) with w_(n,R,Q)>=0 and sum_(Q in Q_n) w_(n,R,Q)=1 for every finite n,R. No values are instantiated here.
symbolic_acceptance_conditions.finite_functional: Define mu_(n,R)(f)=sum_Q w_(n,R,Q) sum_(omega in Omega_(rho_(n,R,Q),Q)) pi_(rho_(n,R,Q))(omega) f(Q,omega).
symbolic_acceptance_conditions.projective_consistency: For every coarse cylinder f, prove sum_(Q_f) w_(n+1,R,Q_f) int f(p_(n+1,n)(x)) d pi_(n+1,R,Q_f)(x) = sum_(Q_c) w_(n,R,Q_c) int f(y) d pi_(n,R,Q_c)(y).
symbolic_acceptance_conditions.cauchy_error: For every finite-support f define epsilon_(i,j)(f)=abs(mu_i(f)-mu_j(f)); provide a source-owned bound tending to zero for the fixed PAH-001 index order, including any boundary term.
symbolic_acceptance_conditions.positivity_and_normalization: The supplied nonnegative normalized weights and component probabilities must imply mu_(n,R)(f)>=0 for f>=0 and mu_(n,R)(1)=1 before any limit claim.
symbolic_acceptance_conditions.r488_nonzero: For each R-488 observable h require an explicit prospective lower bound or witness for liminf mu_(n,R)(h^2)>0; component nonzero witnesses alone do not suffice.
symbolic_acceptance_conditions.stationarity: After the common functional exists, prove mu_(n,R)(L_(n,R)f)=0 on the declared domain and pass this identity to omega only with a uniform integrability or form bound.
symbolic_acceptance_conditions.boundary_accounting: Retain the R-484 hidden-diagonal defect 16/9 as a boundary-error datum. It may be shown to separate from a fixed cylinder after its N(f), but it may not be averaged, cancelled or set to zero.
symbolic_acceptance_conditions.uniformity_role: Use R-490 C_sw=540 only as domination input; it is not a sector law, a probability mass, or a Cauchy proof.

required_source_owner_payload: A versioned law file and SHA-256 hash for w_(n,R,Q) or an equivalent projective full-Q probability kernel.
A proof or exact finite verifier of nonnegativity and normalization for every declared n,R.
A declaration that the law is not selected after seeing the target cylinder values, beta, phase, external source or holdout data.
A topology and explicit epsilon_(i,j)(f) bound with its constants and limit order.
A projective consistency identity tied to the fixed PAH-OMC-012 projection.
A prospective holdout list, including at least one nonzero R-488 observable not used to define the law.
A domain and uniform-integrability condition for the stationary identity omega(Lf)=0.
forbidden_repairs: Uniform weights, partition-function weights, observation-fitted weights or any other law chosen only for this test.
Conditional Gibbs averaging, fixed-Q substitution, charge deletion or redistribution.
Use of C_sw=540 as a sector probability or use of the R-484 16/9 defect cancellation as an error estimate.
Changing PAH-001 functional, rates, regulator path, limit order, cylinder, projection or physical interpretation.
non_claims: This file does not define w_(n,R,Q), mu_(n,R) or omega.
It does not prove projective consistency, a Cauchy limit, stationarity, an infinite-volume state or a semigroup.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion follows.
Markov time remains external stochastic time.
single_next_question: Can the source owner provide the exact hashed sector law and the projective/Cauchy/topology payload listed here without changing PAH-001 or fitting weights?
revisit_condition: Activate the conditional tests only after every required source-owner payload item is present and hash-pinned.
